hypothesis.statement: On a real free-living accelerometer recording (PAMAP2 hand sensor, 100 Hz, 5 s epochs), the newly-authored computeMAD reproduces GGIR::g.applymetrics MAD to machine precision (max |diff| < 1e-9 g, correlation 1.0) across all epochs.

analysis_plan.dataset: PAMAP2 Physical Activity Monitoring dataset, subject 101 hand-worn IMU accelerometer (x, y, z in g at 100 Hz), a ~62-minute free-living recording (749 non-overlapping 5 s epochs)

decision.threshold: descriptive: computeMAD equals GGIR::g.applymetrics MAD to machine precision (max |diff| < 1e-9 g) on the identical signal
